title: SOLD: 2008 Riviera 51 Enclosed Bridge in Miami | FYI Yachts
description: FYI Yachts celebrates the sale of a 2008 Riviera 51 Enclosed Bridge in Miami, showcasing their expertise in the high-performance yacht market.
html:
FYI Yachts proudly announces the successful sale of a 2008 Riviera 51 Enclosed Bridge in Miami, Florida. This premium sportfishing yacht was expertly represented by experienced yacht broker Arney Mendez, marking another strong result for FYI’s brokerage team in the high-performance yacht market.

2008 Riviera 51 Enclosed Bridge Sold by FYI Yachts in Miami

Miami, FL – FYI Yachts is pleased to share the recent sale of a 2008 Riviera 51 Enclosed Bridge, a versatile and well-maintained sportfishing yacht that drew significant interest from qualified buyers. This transaction underscores FYI’s ongoing success in the South Florida yacht market, known for premium listings, deep market knowledge, and professional representation.

Why the Riviera 51 Enclosed Bridge Remains a Top Sportfish Yacht

Built by the renowned Riviera Yachts in Australia, the 51 Enclosed Bridge is a sought-after model for serious offshore anglers and cruising enthusiasts alike. Known for its performance, luxury, and fishability, this 51-foot convertible is a standout in the mid-sized sportfish category.

This particular 2008 model featured:

  • Three staterooms and two heads, offering comfort for extended trips
  • A beam of 16’2”, ensuring spacious interiors and stability underway
  • An enclosed, air-conditioned flybridge, ideal for all-weather navigation
  • Twin Caterpillar C18 1015HP engines for cruising speeds up to 30 knots
  • Upgraded Garmin navigation suite, offering precision and reliability

Its turnkey condition and upgraded equipment made it highly attractive to discerning buyers seeking a capable, ready-to-cruise sportfishing platform.

Standout Features That Drove Buyer Interest

Some of the key features that made this Riviera 51 a compelling choice:

  • Max speed of 35 knots and reliable offshore handling
  • Strataglass flybridge enclosure and aft helm station
  • Teak cockpit, swim platform, and mezzanine seating for premium comfort
  • State-of-the-art electronics: FLIR night vision, SAT TV, Garmin 7212/7215, autopilot, and bow/stern thrusters
  • Elegant salon: high-gloss teak, Samsung/Bose entertainment system, and a built-in wine cooler
  • Chef-ready galley: Corian countertops, 4-drawer Vitrifrigo fridges, washer/dryer combo

This yacht was a prime example of how a well-equipped, professionally marketed listing can attract attention and close quickly.

Arney Mendez: Delivering Results for Buyers and Sellers

“This Riviera 51 was priced right and presented in excellent condition. We had strong buyer interest right away, and the yacht moved quickly,” said Arney Mendez, sportfish specialist at FYI Yachts. “Our goal is always to create a seamless experience for both the buyer and seller, and that’s exactly what happened here.”

Arney’s proven track record, market insight, and strategic approach continue to generate outstanding outcomes for FYI clients throughout the U.S. and internationally.
